ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Account__r.MobilePhone__c = null , ISBLANK( TEXT( LiabilityAttachmentShipping__c ) ) /*自賠取付*/, ISBLANK( TEXT( Image_existence_hs__c ) )/*出品画像有無*/ , ISBLANK( TEXT( VehicleCondition_Supplement_hs__c ) ) /*車両状態*/, ISBLANK( TEXT( StorageStatus_hs__c ) ) /*保管状況*/, ISBLANK( LocationAddress_hs__c ) )/*保管場所住所*/ && NOT( OpportunityOwner__c = null )/*買取商談の所有者*/ && NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL( VehicleClassification__c , "はなまるオークション/他社AA（営業）" ) , ISPICKVAL( VehicleClassification__c , "旧フロー" ) ) )/*ABC区分*/
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 買取商談作成時の入力必須項目に入力がありません。
